item.title: California Attorney General Plants Flag on Paramount-Warner Bros. Merger: “Not a Done Deal”
item.description: If the Justice Department and foreign regulators approves the deal, it'll be up to state attorneys general to challenge the merger.

item.title: Alexa+, Amazon’s New AI Assistant, Now Has Three Personalities
item.description: First introduced in 2025 as an Early Access program, Alexa+ has officially rolled out on all Alexa-enabled devices and, as of yesterday, with three distinct communication styles.

item.title: What the Former Faithfuls Had to Say About ‘The Traitors’ Season 4
item.description: Faithfuls like Monét X Change, Kristen Kish and more weigh in on their time in the castle ahead of the show’s finale.

item.title: Artios Awards for Casting: ‘Sinners,’ ‘Sentimental Value’ Lead Winners
item.description: 'Sinners' beat out several fellow nominees in the first-ever Oscars casting category, while over in TV, awards darlings 'The Pitt,' 'The Studio' and 'Adolescence' showed no signs of slowing down.

item.title: Ryan Gosling’s ‘Project Hail Mary’: First Reactions
item.description: Phil Lord and Christopher Miller's adaptation of Andy Weir's bestselling hard sci-fi book hits theaters on March 20.

item.title: NAACP Image Awards Creative Honors: ‘Sinners,’ ‘Abbott Elementary’ Top Winners
item.description: Additional non-televised award recipients were recognized on Thursday night.
